- Notice when you're doing this and pause. Ask "would I have thought this remarkable if I wasn't already primed to?"
- If this kind of pattern-matching is spreading to other areas of life or creating anxiety, that's worth talking to someone about (therapist, doctor)

- It's starting to feel emotionally significant and isolating
